name: Wang Haijun
current_role: Founder, Chairman and CEO, Atour Lifestyle Holdings (Nasdaq: ATAT)
profile: Wang Haijun (王海军) founded Atour, China's largest mid-to-upscale hotel chain, in 2012-13 after years at Home Inns, Jinjiang Inn and as EVP of China Lodging (now H World). Atour listed on Nasdaq in 2022 and pairs hotels with a fast-growing sleep-products retail business. He is a Yanshan University graduate with a CEIBS EMBA.
interesting_fact: Atour also runs a large retail arm selling the pillows, bedding and mattresses guests use in its hotels, a key growth driver alongside its hotel network.
deep_cut_fact: Atour is named after Yaduo (亚朵) village in Nujiang, Yunnan: after leaving Hanting in 2012 Wang travelled to Bhutan and Nepal, then found in Yaduo the same simple contentment and named the brand after it. He long used the nickname 耶律胤 (Yelü Yin), a nod to his reported Khitan ancestry.
notes: Hosts quarterly earnings calls in English/Chinese; IR via Christensen Advisory is the most practical route.
